result.question: How many Cybertrucks did Tesla deliver in each month of the last quarter?
result.answer: The available SEC filing evidence does not support a month-by-month breakdown of Cybertruck deliveries for any quarter. Tesla's SEC filing excerpts present vehicle delivery data organized by quarter and full year, with no monthly delivery breakdowns appearing in any of the provided evidence [0000950170-24-040274:ex-99-press-release-p001]. Tesla's delivery tables group vehicles into two categories — "Model 3/Y" and "Other Models" — without a separate Cybertruck delivery line item [0000950170-24-040274:ex-99-press-release-p001]. The Q1 2024 10-Q states that "there was an increase of approximately 7,000 deliveries of other models as we ramped our production of Cybertruck," indicating that Cybertruck deliveries are included within the "Other Models" delivery category [0001628280-24-017503:part-i--item-2-p006]. The evidence does mention Cybertruck production milestones — for example, Tesla stated it "produced over 1,000 Cybertrucks in a single week in April" [0000950170-24-046895:ex-99-press-release-p003] — but no monthly Cybertruck delivery figures are provided. Therefore, the specific number of Cybertrucks delivered in each month of the last quarter cannot be determined from the available SEC filing evidence.
